title: Sheep with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7c0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <g fill='#f2f2f2'>
    <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='20'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='46' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='60' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='60' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='11'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='11'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='11'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wool shading highlights -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='5'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='42' r='5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a4632'/>
  <rect x='54' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a4632'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='39' y='82' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3d3428'/>
  <rect x='53' y='82' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3d3428'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#3d3830'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='44' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3d3830' transform='rotate(-20 33 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='44' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3d3830' transform='rotate(20 67 44)'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='44' cy='51' r='4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='51' r='4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#c9d6e3'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 61 Q50 64 54 61' stroke='#c9d6e3' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
